title: KO Presence Report
statSummary: {analysed} genomes analysed · {shown} shown · {hidden} without target KOs (hidden) · {kos} target KOs
metaSignificantOnly: Scanned with --significant-only (below-threshold hits are not included)
aboutMatrix: Rows are genomes and columns are KOs. Dark green is a hit above the KofamScan threshold, light green means below-threshold hits only, and pale grey means absent. The small bar under each heading is the share of listed genomes carrying that KO.
aboutAggregate: In the overview a genome is thinner than 1px, so each screen pixel summarises the genomes it covers and the colour strength shows the share carrying the KO. Zoom in to see one genome per row; genome IDs appear once rows are at least 10px tall.
aboutOps: Hover a row or a column heading for details. Click a cell to pin the details and open NCBI / KEGG links (× or Esc to close). The Overview / Detail buttons switch views, and Detail returns to where you left off. Clicking in the overview opens the detail view at that position. Click a KO heading or "KOs" to sort.
aboutCaveat: Shows KO presence only. Distinguishing enzymes that share KOs (amo/pmo, nxr/nar, direction of dsr, etc.) requires phylogenetic or other analyses.
viewOverviewTitle: Show all genomes on one screen (several genomes per pixel)
viewDetailTitle: One row per genome (returns to where you last zoomed in)
searchPlaceholder: Filter by genome ID, organism or taxon
hideEmpty: Hide genomes without KOs in the visible columns
exportTitle: Save the {n} listed genomes as TSV
sortHintGenome: Click to sort by genome ID
sortHintCount: Click to sort by number of KOs (again: reverse, then by ID)
koSortHint: Click to list genomes carrying this KO first
tipNoKos: No KOs in the visible columns
taxSortTitle: Sort by taxonomy (domain → species) and show the tree
aboutTree: The tree on the left is the NCBI Taxonomy classification (domain → phylum → class → order → family → genus → species). No distances are computed, so branch lengths carry no meaning. Hover a branch or a phylum name on the far left to see the taxon at that rank. While sorted by a KO heading or "KOs" the tree is hidden; the Taxonomy tree button restores the taxonomic order. Search also matches organism and taxon names.
